# infisical_pam_account_postgres (Resource)

Create and manage PostgreSQL accounts in Infisical PAM. The connection is tested when the account is created or its connection changes. Only Machine Identity authentication is supported for this resource.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    infisical = {
      # version = <latest version>
      source = "infisical/infisical"
    }
  }
}

provider "infisical" {
  host = "https://app.infisical.com" # Only required if using self hosted instance of Infisical, default is https://app.infisical.com
  auth = {
    universal = {
      client_id     = "<machine-identity-client-id>"
      client_secret = "<machine-identity-client-secret>"
    }
  }
}

data "infisical_gateway" "main" {
  name = "prod-gateway"
}

resource "infisical_pam_folder" "dbas" {
  name = "dbas"
}

resource "infisical_pam_account_template" "postgres" {
  name         = "postgres-rotated"
  account_type = "postgres"
  gateway_id   = data.infisical_gateway.main.id

  settings = {
    rotation = {
      enabled          = true
      interval_seconds = 604800
    }
  }
}

resource "infisical_pam_account_postgres" "admin" {
  name        = "orders-admin"
  folder_id   = infisical_pam_folder.dbas.id
  template_id = infisical_pam_account_template.postgres.id

  connection_details = {
    host     = "orders.db.internal"
    database = "orders"
  }

  credentials = {
    username = "orders_admin"
    password = var.orders_admin_password
  }

  rotation_account_id = "self"
}

resource "infisical_pam_account_postgres" "app" {
  name        = "orders-app"
  folder_id   = infisical_pam_folder.dbas.id
  template_id = infisical_pam_account_template.postgres.id

  connection_details = {
    host     = "orders.db.internal"
    database = "orders"
  }

  credentials = {
    username = "orders_app"
    password = var.orders_app_password
  }

  # The admin account rotates this account's password.
  rotation_account_id = infisical_pam_account_postgres.admin.id
}

resource "infisical_pam_account_postgres" "rds" {
  name        = "reporting-iam"
  folder_id   = infisical_pam_folder.dbas.id
  template_id = infisical_pam_account_template.postgres.id

  connection_details = {
    host     = "reporting.abc123.us-east-1.rds.amazonaws.com"
    database = "reporting"
  }

  credentials = {
    auth_method = "aws-iam"
    username    = "reporting"
    aws_region  = "us-east-1"
    role_arn    = "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/infisical-pam-rds"
  }
}

variable "orders_admin_password" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

variable "orders_app_password" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `connection_details` (Attributes) How to reach the PostgreSQL target. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--connection_details))
- `credentials` (Attributes) The credentials of the account. Secrets are never read back, so changes made outside of Terraform, such as rotation, aren't detected. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--credentials))
- `folder_id` (String) The ID of the folder the account is in. Changing it moves the account.
- `name` (String) The name of the account, unique in its folder. Must be lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens, at most 64 characters.
- `template_id` (String) The ID of the account template the account uses, which must be a `postgres` template.

### Optional

- `description` (String) An optional description of the account.
- `gateway_id` (String) The ID of the gateway to connect through instead of the template's.
- `gateway_pool_id` (String) The ID of the gateway pool to connect through instead of the template's.
- `rotation_account_id` (String) The ID of another account of the same type and target that rotates this account's password, or `self` for the account to rotate its own. Rotation is enabled on the template.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of the account.

<a id="nestedatt--connection_details"></a>
### Nested Schema for `connection_details`

Required:

- `database` (String) The name of the database to connect to.
- `host` (String) The hostname or IP address of the database server.

Optional:

- `port` (Number) The port of the database server. Defaults to 5432.
- `ssl_certificate` (String) The PEM-encoded CA certificate to verify the server with.
- `ssl_enabled` (Boolean) Whether to connect over TLS. Must be true for the `aws-iam` auth method. Defaults to true.
- `ssl_reject_unauthorized` (Boolean) Whether to reject a server certificate that isn't trusted. Defaults to true.


<a id="nestedatt--credentials"></a>
### Nested Schema for `credentials`

Required:

- `username` (String) The database user.

Optional:

- `auth_method` (String) How the account authenticates: `password`, or `aws-iam` for RDS and Aurora IAM authentication. Defaults to `password`.
- `aws_region` (String) The AWS region of the RDS or Aurora instance, for the `aws-iam` auth method.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) The password, for the `password` auth method.
- `role_arn` (String) The ARN of the IAM role Infisical assumes to generate the auth token, for the `aws-iam` auth method. It needs `rds-db:connect` and must trust Infisical with your organization ID as the external ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
# This will import the PostgreSQL PAM account by its ID.
# Secrets are never read back, so set the credentials in the configuration after importing.
terraform import infisical_pam_account_postgres.example <account_id>
```
